label: preparing
what: Innkeeper, freight, and builder are jointly preparing an eighteen-hour great hall gathering with bread and refreshments. They have disclosed a civic hospitality appointment to me but not its detailed agenda or actual occasion. Baker is helping supply bread and reconcile payment; secretary knowingly assists with scheduling and escorting me, though may not know the undisclosed purpose. There is insufficient evidence to identify a more specific hidden occasion, or to count neighbour as an organizer.
